privacy.privacy_policy_url: https://admin.typeform.com/to/dwk6gt/ (Trust Center policy selector: option C Privacy Policy; DPA is option D)
privacy.ai_training_note: Typeform states none of its customers' data is used to train any model regardless of the underlying provider. AI features run on private model copies (including Anthropic and others) so respondent data is not sent to providers for training; for some analysis features only the form's questions and answer choices (not respondent answers) are sent, and PII is excluded. ISO/IEC 42001 certification provides independent validation of its AI governance. Verified via Typeform's AI FAQ summary (help center page returned 403 to automated fetch, so the no-training claim is corroborated but not captured as a verbatim on-domain quote).
privacy.data_region: US by default; EU data residency available for EU-hosting customers (subprocessors AWS and Okta noted as 'US / EU (for EU hosting customers)'; Salesforce EU). US and EU data centers.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Data encryption utilized (control listed under Product security on Trust Center); admin-security page references encryption controls. Standard TLS in transit / encryption at rest for a platform at this maturity.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Yes - 'Penetration testing performed' control listed; a Penetration Test report is available under Trust Center Additional Resources.

security.name: MFA / access control
security.value: Remote access MFA enforced; unique account and network authentication enforced (Infrastructure security controls).

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Dedicated security vulnerability reporting program via help center ('How to report a security vulnerability to Typeform'). A formal public bug-bounty platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) is not confirmed from Typeform's own domain; treat as VDP confirmed, paid bug-bounty platform unverified.

security.name: Business continuity / DR
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established and tested; cybersecurity insurance maintained.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Published list: AWS (cloud infra + AI features, US/EU), Okta (identity, US/EU), Salesforce (CRM, EU), Snowflake (data warehouse, US).

products.name: Intelligent Forms (core Typeform)
products.data_scope: Collects respondent/zero-party data; AI builds forms and runs topic/sentiment analysis. Customer + response data stored US or EU.
products.notes: Core product; 48M+ responses/month. AI analysis runs on private model copies, not used for training.

products.name: Growth Flow
products.data_scope: Enriches lead/customer data, builds segments, triggers email/SMS follow-ups; integrates Stripe, PayPal, Calendly, Google Calendar. Broader PII and payment-adjacent data flows.
products.notes: Newer module; data enrichment expands data scope beyond form responses - reviewers handling regulated data should scope this separately.

products.name: Research Flow
products.data_scope: Runs AI-moderated text/video/voice interviews at scale, recruits verified panels, captures voice/video and incentive/payment data.
products.notes: Newer module; voice/video capture and panel recruitment add biometric-adjacent and respondent-PII considerations.

products.name: Developer API & embeds
products.data_scope: REST API and embeds for programmatic form/response access under Developer Terms and Conditions.
products.notes: Governed by separate Developer Terms; same underlying compliance posture.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS with paid Basic/Plus/Business tiers plus custom Enterprise plans (free 'Get started' tier advertised).
compare.data_residency: US default, EU data residency option for EU-hosting customers

flags: AI no-training claim is well-corroborated (search summary of Typeform AI FAQ + ISO 42001 cert) but the help-center FAQ page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so it was not captured as a verbatim on-domain quote.
Vulnerability disclosure program confirmed on Typeform's domain, but a paid public bug-bounty platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) could not be confirmed from a first-party source.
Privacy Policy and DPA live behind a Trust Center document selector (admin.typeform.com/to/dwk6gt) rather than a static URL.
Newer Growth Flow and Research Flow modules expand data scope (enrichment, voice/video, payments); compliance reports cover the platform but per-module scoping is advisable for regulated buyers.
